machine_notes: Apple M1 Pro; 32 GiB RAM; sequential runs, no concurrent agent test/benchmark jobs; background load, power mode and thermal state not controlled
minizinc:
MiniZinc to FlatZinc converter, version 2.9.7, build 2490193457
Copyright (C) 2014-2026 Monash University, NICTA, Data61

protocol.timing: fresh solver process: startup, JSON parsing, model preparation and search, output rendering and Snarky primitive checks; MiniZinc compilation and external correctness checks excluded
protocol.snarky_policy: dom_wdeg; declared ascending values; FlatZinc search annotations not translated
protocol.prune_policy: upstream defaults and declared annotations; automatic portfolio where unannotated
protocol.validation: Gecode original-model reference plus fixed-output validation; Snarky independently checks original FlatZinc constraints
protocol.heldout: Not used for adapter development or policy tuning
